scope: One defined output and one inclusive planning period. Fictional assumptions, not observed data or measured impact.

cells.B3: Illustrative planning assumptions. No observed data, measured impact or charity rating.
cells.C12: Count each completed fictional workshop once.
cells.C18: Staff, direct and allocated shared cash costs.
cells.C19: Unpriced volunteer time and donated inputs.
cells.H10: Edit the blue / amber input cells. Formulas are unlocked and visible.
cells.H11: USD only. No currency or inflation conversion.
cells.H12: Blank is unknown. Enter 0 only for an explicit zero.
cells.H13: Use the same period for costs and output counts.
cells.H15: Planning dates and price year are fictional, not source publication dates.
cells.H17: A completed output is not a measured benefit or causal effect.
cells.H19: Keep omissions and the counting rule explicit.
cells.H24: Illustrative authored assumption. Source date unknown.
cells.H25: Illustrative authored assumption. Source date unknown.
cells.H26: Illustrative authored assumption. Source date unknown.
cells.H31: Illustrative assumption. Count each completed fictional workshop once; source date unknown.
cells.B35: The lower ratio uses lower cost / upper outputs. The upper ratio uses upper cost / lower outputs.
cells.B36: These are conditional arithmetic bounds. They are not probabilities, percentiles or confidence intervals.
cells.B37: Only the uncertainty you enter is covered. Unknown bounds do not erase a valid point estimate.
cells.B40: Planned cash cost divided by one defined output count. No outcomes, counterfactuals or discounting.
cells.B41: This separate planner does not run, import or reproduce the frozen Model Kit v1 simulation.
cells.B42: Template method: planned-cash-cost-per-defined-output-v1. Authoring/formula specification is public.
cells.B43: Use costs and defined outputs to inspect the charity system; feedback can revise the assumptions.
cells.H20: Keep personal or restricted source text out of copies you share.

formulas.E21: =IF(COUNTBLANK(C10:C20)>0,"Missing definition",IF(COUNT(C13:C15)<>3,"Check dates / year",IF(OR(C13<>INT(C13),C14<>INT(C14),C13<DATE(1900,1,1),C14>DATE(2200,12,31),C14<C13,C15<>INT(C15),C15<1900,C15>2200,C16<>"Nominal planned cash costs"),"Check dates / basis","Complete")))
formulas.H5: =IF(E21<>"Complete",E21,IF(NOT(ISNUMBER(D27)),"Point cash cost is unknown or invalid.",IF(NOT(ISNUMBER(D31)),"Point output count is unknown or invalid.",IF(OR(D31<0,D31>1000000000,D31<>INT(D31)),"Point output count is invalid.",IF(D31=0,"No outputs in the point estimate.","USD per "&C11)))))
formulas.H6: =IF(E6="n.a.",IF(AND(ISNUMBER(E31),E31=0),"No outputs at the upper output bound.","Required bounds or definition are unknown / invalid."),"Conditional on the supplied bounds.")
formulas.H7: =IF(E7="Unbounded","Zero lower output permits no finite upper ratio.",IF(E7="n.a.",IF(AND(ISNUMBER(E27),E27=0,ISNUMBER(C31),C31=0),"0 cost / 0 outputs is undefined.","Required bounds or definition are unknown / invalid."),"Conditional on the supplied bounds."))

semantics.zeroCost: Numeric zero for positive defined output count.
semantics.zeroPointOutputs: Point ratio unavailable; no outputs in point estimate.
semantics.zeroLowerOutputs: Upper ratio unbounded when positive cost is possible; 0/0 remains undefined.
semantics.bounds: Author-supplied conditional arithmetic bounds, not probability intervals.
semantics.knownInputBounds: Each provided lower/point/upper value must be ordered; missing bounds do not invalidate a valid point estimate.
semantics.sample: All numbers, dates, source descriptions and outputs are fictional authored assumptions.
